items.title: BlackRock (BLK) Hands Off Jessup Power Plant Control As Data Center Demand Climbs
items.summary: BlackRock (NYSE:BLK) has agreed to sell a majority stake in the Jessup power plant to Equinor, transferring control of the asset from a BlackRock subsidiary. The deal comes as electricity demand from regional data centers rises and pushes utilities and investors to secure dependable power sources. The transaction highlights BlackRock's current focus on reshaping its infrastructure portfolio around energy assets linked to digital and AI growth. Equinor's entry as the lead owner of Jessup...

items.title: Nvidia’s Blockbuster Quarter Has One Ugly Loose End. $27 Billion of Free Cash Flow Vanished
